title: Fresh concerns raised over Gaza doctor held by Israel for 23 months without charge
summary_full: Independent Israeli professor says Hussam Abu Safiya’s life will be at risk until he receives proper medical treatmentAn independent professor who reviewed the medical records of a prominent Gaza doctor held in an Israeli prison without charge for nearly 23 months has raised serious concerns about his health.Hussam Abu Safiya was detained at work on 27 December 2024 and later held in solitary confinement at Rakefet, a notorious underground prison.
